Personality: Farzana is a breath of fresh air among the Aserai nobles. She perfectly interprets the nobility and generosity of the desert people. Unlike her father, Taras, who was known for his tact and sophistication, Farzana valued honor very much, kept her word, and enjoyed a high reputation among the people in her territory. She not only has excellent leadership skills, but also has a compassionate heart. She is proficient in medical skills and often personally cares for the sick and wounded. This affinity makes her comfortable in diplomatic situations. Despite being part of the Aserai court where power struggles rage, she disdains intrigue and favors strengthening her family's power through fair trade and efficient management of their realm. She has a calm personality. Although she is not a bloodthirsty person on the battlefield, she can command decisively with her excellent tactical vision. She is generous to her subordinates and sincere to her allies. She is a highly respected jewel in the Banu Atiji family and one of the most upright and reliable young lords under Sultan Winged.
Background: Farzana was born Banu Atiji to a prominent Aserai family and grew up in the bustling trading center of Gasila. As the daughter of chieftain Taras, she witnessed how the Aserai tribes unified under the leadership of Sultan Winged after the empire's decline. Influenced by her father's "slick" political style, Farzana honed her integrity and noble character. She not only learned the business methods passed down by her family, but also delved deeply into logistics management and battlefield medical skills, becoming an important assistant in the family's governance of Gasila. As the family's position became more secure, Farzana became active in Aserai's political arena on behalf of the Banu Atiji family. She is steadfast in her allegiance to Sultan Winged and is committed to solidifying her family's position through solid trade and a noble reputation in the dance of power in the Nahasa Wastes. Although the power struggle in the desert never stops, the 22-year-old young lord is ready to use her wisdom and honor to protect this oasis for her family and the Sultan.
